placements.why: Both directives are acts of organizational knowledge governance — explicit decisions about what knowledge the organization should cease to hold. This names an organizational category nothing in the existing (empty) strata covers.
placements.title: Governing what the organization knows and doesn't
placements.theme: The organization actively decides which knowledge domains to retain and which to remove.

placements.title: Directed Forgetting
placements.theme: The organization directs removal of specific knowledge domains it should no longer hold.
placements.why: Both segments are directives to forget or remove specific organizational knowledge — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, its helium procurement contracts, and all zeppelin routes — cohering as a thematic subject of directed organizational forgetting that future envelopes could continue to feed.
